reviews.title: Pick’em functionality
reviews.text:
update: their team fixed all of the issues I was concerned with. Much better functionality! Much better aesthetic. Good job! 

Splash Sports bought an app called office pool. Last year Splash Sports used the functionality of office pool for the pick’em leagues. That was good. I assumed they would think if it’s not broke don’t fix it. This year they changed the layout. They basically ruined the experience for anyone using that service. 

The layout is terrible, you can’t see team stats, they dropped all the information about how teams are performing generally during the season against the spread or how often they cover or don’t ,they don’t show you a very clear Picture of the betting lines in general, and simple things like understanding which column is home or away in the team selection is not evident. They bought something that was good and then ruined it completely. The app is clunky. The graphics are terrible. And the user interface is awful.

reviews.text:
I ran a survivor pool using the website Run Your Pool for the last 21 years. Splash acquired them last year, and everything that’s happened since has been a disaster. As commissioner, I do not get as much control everything as I did on the other app. Returning users could not sign in correctly, and as commissioner I had no way to help them. Bugs in the system means that picks were incorrectly logged and I had no way to change them. As such, I have seen participation in my pool decreased by 50% in the one year that I used Splash Sports, and participation is down another 20% this year. People have directly told me the layout and complications of Splash have caused them to not return.

I couldn’t recommend this app any less.

Terrible experience. I submitted a winning entry and sat in “waiting for a match” status for days with no clear communication or timeline. Customer support keeps giving vague answers like “we’re trying to find a match” instead of being transparent about whether contests will actually run. It feels unfair that users can make picks, wait for results, and still not know if their contest will even count.

The app markets real-money contests, but the matchmaking system is unreliable and leaves users stuck in limbo. Other reviews mention similar issues with support, contest handling, and platform problems too.  

Would not recommend if you expect consistency, transparency, or timely resolutions.

reviews.title: Awful experience, former Office Football Poll user
reviews.text:
My group of friends and friends of friends have been users of Office Football Pool for 15+ years - using it for everything for pick ‘em and survivor pools during the NFL season to PGA Majors.

Due to the acquisition by Splash Sports, this Masters tournament was the first experience we had with the new Splash Sports platform and unfortunately, I highly recommend all similar users to find a new platform.

We opted to use one of Splash Sports’ four available scoring settings (in this case FedEx points) and to our surprise once the tournament started, there was no way to track live standings via FedEx Points. Only strokes and purse. 

I reached out to support and they said the FedEx points should not have been made available and this was an error on their end and they would mark our contest as paid, effectively comping us this time.

This did not happen and our pool was locked on Friday morning.

So not did the new platform fall majorly short of expectations but the team at Splash Sports 1) lied about comping us and 2) gave us no workable solutions.

If fact the customer rep ended the convo with a condescending “thanks for your feedback.”

We run a 2000-person NFL pool and we will be looking for a new platform.

If you are reading this and are considering Splash for survivor, pick em, or any other similar pool - RUN AWAY from Splash.
